What Is a CMP?

A Content Marketing Platform (CMP) is a centralized software solution that streamlines the entire content marketing process, from planning and creation to multi-channel distribution. By offering full visibility across the content lifecycle, CMPs help ensure brand consistency, support data-driven decisions, and deliver relevant content to the right audience, ultimately driving engagement, lead nurturing, and revenue through high-quality storytelling.

value_i18n.en_US: From audit to fixes in minutes, at scale
Scan your whole site for issues and opportunities

Liferay SEO & AEO Studio monitors your site and surfaces prioritized improvement opportunities for both traditional search and AI answer engine visibility. Each insight provides clear explanations of what is broken, why it matters, and what to do next.
Let AI Agents do the heavy work

With the auto fix tool, specialized AI agents generate missing meta descriptions, alt tags, structured data, and AI-ready summaries for your content. Say goodbye to issues like internal 404s, redirect chains, missing page metadata, or unoptimized content.
Stop losing visibility in AI answer engines
Understand how AI answer engines are using your content. Discover how to improve your site to make ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Claude, and other AI tools cite your brand even more.
The right metrics, in one place
By connecting data from Liferay DXP, Google Search Console, and PageSpeed Insights, Liferay SEO & AEO Studio gives marketing and IT teams the right performance data at the right time.

<style>
  .dxp-gradient-text mark {
    color: #8881f9;
    background-image: linear-gradient(90deg, #659aff, #7414ff80);
    background-clip: text;
    -webkit-background-clip: text;
    -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
  }

.dxp-capabilities-description .highlight {
	color: #C379FB;
	font-weight: 700;
}
  
.ai-hub-sticky.stop-sticky {
	position: static !important;
	top: auto !important;
}

</style>
<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
	const stickyElement = document.querySelector('.ai-hub-sticky');
	const lastSection = document.querySelector('#ai-hub-plans');
	const purchaseButton = document.querySelector(
		'a[href="#ai-hub-plans"]'
	);

	if (purchaseButton && lastSection) {
		purchaseButton.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
			event.preventDefault();

			window.scrollTo({
				top: lastSection.offsetTop,
				behavior: 'smooth',
			});
		});
	}

	if (stickyElement && lastSection) {
		const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
			([entry]) => {
				
				stickyElement.classList.toggle(
					'stop-sticky',
					entry.intersectionRatio >= 0.5
				);
			},
			{
				rootMargin: '0px 0px -200px 0px',
				threshold: 0.5,
			}
		);

		observer.observe(lastSection);
	}
});
</script>
